items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I met him out there.

ctx.x: Milt Hinton has talked about him quite a bit.

Yeah, I met him out there. And luckily, I met a piano player up there who was looking for a trumpet player, so he asked me was I working, and I said, "You got a job?" He said, "Yeah." I said, "Well, I am now. Well, what it is." So he was working in St. Paul. Anyway, I went over to St. Paul to work for him, and thank goodness, because it was colder than a son-of-a-bitch. You talk about cold, boy, St. Paul and Minneapolis was out of sight.
